charm.how: Complete the Paldea Pokédex, then talk to Jacq at the academy.

methods.name: Random encounters
methods.plain: Any Pokémon you meet has a 1 in 4,096 chance to be shiny.
methods.detail: One try per Pokémon, 3 with the Shiny Charm. Fixed-symbol Pokémon in the overworld get 1 try and no bonus [single].

methods.name: Masuda Method
methods.plain: Breed two Pokémon whose games are in different languages: the eggs have a much better shiny chance.
methods.detail: 6 tries per egg, 8 with the Shiny Charm.
methods.note: Serebii; RotomLabs; same egg code as Gen 8

methods.name: Breeding (same-language parents)
methods.plain: Ordinary eggs have the normal shiny chance; the Shiny Charm helps them too.
methods.detail: 1 try, 2 with the Shiny Charm. Quirk: with the charm but no Masuda Method an egg gets 2 tries, not 3, because the egg code skips the normal first try.
methods.note: Same egg code as Gen 8 (Admiral-Fish); RotomLabs

methods.name: Mass outbreak
methods.plain: Defeat or catch 60 Pokémon from an outbreak: the rest of that outbreak has better shiny odds.
methods.detail: 30–59 cleared: +1 try; 60 or more: +2. Assumed the same in Kitakami and Blueberry.
methods.note: Anubis via RotomLabs; Kitakami / Blueberry assumed [single]

methods.name: Sparkling Power
methods.plain: Eat a sandwich with Sparkling Power: wild Pokémon of its type get better shiny odds.
methods.detail: Level 1/2/3: +1/+2/+3 tries, for wild Pokémon of that type only (not eggs or raids).

methods.name: Outbreak with Sparkling Power
methods.plain: Clear 60 from an outbreak, then eat a level 3 Sparkling Power sandwich of its type: about 1 in 512 with the Shiny Charm, the best odds in the game.
methods.detail: Outbreak +2, Sparkling Power +3, Shiny Charm +2: 8 tries.

methods.name: Tera Raid Battles
methods.plain: Tera Raid Pokémon (1 to 6 stars) can be shiny at about 1 in 4,096; the Shiny Charm and sandwiches don't help.
methods.detail: Fixed by the raid's seed. 7-star raids are events and never shiny.
